acq_time.Description: Acquisition date and time (UTC) from ZEN metadata; n/a if no metadata survives

magnification.Description: Total magnification incl. 10x eyepiece (12.5X overview, 100X, 200X), inferred from image content

magnification_confidence.Description: high/low: from DAPI nucleus scale; rule: Abeta42 focal stack without a matching DAPI image, assigned 200X

source_format.Description: czi: original raw data; jpg: original CZI missing or corrupted, 8-bit JPG export used

region.Description: Imaged region, parsed from the original subfolder name; n/a if not recorded

region_abbr.Description: Region abbreviation as used in Wright et al. (2025)

original_subfolder.Description: Original subfolder name within the mouse folder

original_file.Description: Path of the source file in the original repository
